visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Every Pair Is Swapped Twice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The transpose of 1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9 should start with 1 4 7, but the matrix prints unchanged.

solution.explanation: Swapping in place must visit each pair of mirrored elements once, so only the part above the diagonal (j > i) is looped over. Starting j at 0 visits every pair twice, and the second swap undoes the first.
